primary_analysis: Paired estimator = mean_i(llm_i - baseline_i) over N=120 tasks (per preregistration). Inference: 95% bootstrap CI from 10,000 resamples of paired differences; two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on paired differences. Implemented by paired_binary_analysis_v1 against execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json.
secondary_analyses: seed_sensitivity_failure_rate (exploratory): assess change in per-task pass probability across seeds_1..seed_4 using additional LLM outputs (per preregistration)
rank_stability_kendall_tau (exploratory): Kendall tau on task success-rate rankings across 1000 bootstrap resamples (pre-specified exploratory)
sensitivity_analyses: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity: treat failed model/verifier calls as verifier-failures (binary=0) and recompute primary estimand (per preregistration)

contamination sensitivity: (a) exclude tasks flagged as suspected_contamination and recompute estimand; (b) worst-case: force suspected_contamination items to failure and recompute estimand (per preregistration)
uncertainty_quantification: Primary CI: bootstrap 95% CI from 10,000 resamples of paired differences. Wilcoxon paired test p-value reported. Kendall-tau rank-stability uses 1,000 bootstrap resamples. All bootstrap replicates archived in statistical results file.
multiplicity_implementation: Single pre-specified primary confirmatory test (H1) at alpha=0.05. All other analyses are labeled exploratory and reported without multiplicity correction (per preregistration).
contamination_analysis: Detection per preregistration: exact-match flag 'verbatim_match_suspected_contamination'; normalized 5-gram overlap >= 0.95 => 'suspected_contamination'; normalized Levenshtein >= 0.9 and not exact-match => 'high_overlap'. Primary reporting is inclusive of all tasks. Sensitivity reports: (1) excluding suspected_contamination items and (2) forcing suspected_contamination items to failure (worst-case).
table_specifications: Table 1: Aggregate verifier pass rates by condition (baseline vs guarded) overall and stratified by topology class (edge/datacenter/multi‑AS). Columns: N, pass_count, pass_rate, 95% bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples). Source: execution/scoring/*.json and execution/task_manifest.jsonl.

Table 2: Per-task paired outcomes (task_id, topology_class, baseline_pass (0/1), llm_pass_seed0 (0/1), paired_difference, contamination_flag, parse_fail_flag). Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json.

Table 3 (exploratory): Semantic-error taxonomy counts and examples by class (parse/ACL/BGP/misapplied-route) with topology and vendor-syntax cross-tab. Source: automated error-label fields in execution/scoring/*.json (exploratory-coded from verifier logs).
figure_specifications: Figure 1: Bar chart of verifier pass rates (baseline vs guarded) broken out by topology class with 95% bootstrap CI error bars (produceable from execution/scoring/*.json).

Figure 2: Histogram or violin plot of bootstrap distribution (10,000 replicates) of paired success-rate difference (guarded minus baseline) with observed mean and CI annotated (from analysis bootstrap replicates).
Figure 3: Scatter plot of per-task baseline_pass vs llm_pass_seed0 (jittered), color-coded by contamination_flag; report Kendall tau and its bootstrap CI (from 1,000 resamples).
Figure 4 (exploratory): Heatmap of error-taxonomy frequency by topology × vendor-syntax (from execution/scoring verifier logs).
